# Drop & Pop 3D

> Drop & Pop 3D is a free, relaxing 3D merge puzzle game for Android by NOVRA Games. Players drop cute 3D toys into a jar; two identical toys merge into a bigger toy, and the goal is to reach the giant toy.

## Key facts
- Developer / publisher: NOVRA Games
- Platform: Android (Android 8.0 or newer). No iOS version yet.
- Price: free to play, with optional in-app purchases and ads (a No Ads purchase is available)
- Genre: puzzle, merge, casual
- Content: 100+ levels in 25 worlds, 58 living toys, a boss level every 10 levels (Grumpy King Bonk), a Daily Challenge with a daily leaderboard, monthly leaderboard, seasonal events (Halloween, Christmas, New Year, Eid), sticker album, Toy Room, power-ups (Hammer, Bomb, Fire)
- Works offline; internet only needed for leaderboards, cloud save and reward videos
- Cloud save through Google Play Games
